# Kaqchikel grammar, chapter by chapter

The compressed pattern tables of every chapter of *Kaqchikel from the Ground Up*.
This is the whole grammar in tables; for the reasoning behind a pattern, read the
chapter itself in `textbook/`. Set A = ergative (transitive subject, possessor),
Set B = absolutive (intransitive subject, transitive object, non-verbal subject).


## Chapter 1: Sounds and Spelling

### Consonants

| | Bilabial | Dental/alveolar | Alveopalatal | Velar | Post-velar | Glottal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plain stop/affricate | p | t, tz | ch | k | q | ' |
| Glottalized | b' | t', tz' | ch' | k' | q' | |
| Fricative | | s | x | | | j |
| Nasal | m | n | | | | |
| Other | w | l, r | y | | | |

### Vowels

| Tense | a | e | i | o | u |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lax | ä | ë | ï | ö | ü |

### Rules to remember

| Rule | Example |
|---|---|
| Lax vowels occur only in final syllables; they tense when a suffix follows. | winäq > winaqi' |
| Word-initial glottal stop is not written; medial and final ones are. | ixim; ye'el; ya' |
| w, y, l, r devoice at the end of a word. | tew, k'iy, ko'öl, yiwär |
| Stress on the final syllable, except vocatives táta, nána. | tinaMIT, samaJEL |
| Statements and wh-questions fall; yes/no questions rise. | ¿La ütz awäch? (rise) |
| Greetings: last syllable two beats, high then low; k'a carries a rise-fall. | Xseqë-ër; Xseqër k'a |

## Chapter 2: How a Kaqchikel Sentence Works

### Design principles

| Principle | What it means for you |
|---|---|
| Predicate first | Find the verb / predicate word first when reading; put it first when speaking. |
| No copula | Nouns and adjectives are predicates on their own: In tijonel; Nim ri jay. |
| Subject inside the predicate | Free pronouns and noun phrases are optional; use them for clarity or emphasis. |
| Two marker sets | Set B: intransitive subject, transitive object, subject of non-verbal predicate. Set A: transitive subject, possessor. |
| Verb template | ASPECT + Set B + Set A + stem. Object marker precedes subject marker. |
| Zero 3sB | Explains n-/y- and xt-/xk- alternation; "it" objects are invisible. |
| Order VOS / VS | After the verb: object, then subject. Front position = topic/focus. |
| ri / jun | "the" (known) / "a, one" (new). |

### Aspect prefixes

| | before zero 3sB | elsewhere |
|---|---|---|
| incompletive (present) | n- | y- |
| completive (past) | x- | x- |
| potential (future) | xt- | xk- |
| imperative / hortative | t- | k- |

### Person markers (summary)

| | Set B prefix (C / V) | Set B free word | Set A on nouns (C / V) | Set A on verbs (C / V) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1s | i- / in- | in | nu- / w- | in- / inw- |
| 2s | a- / at- | at | a- / aw- | a- / aw- |
| 3s | Ø / Ø | Ø | ru- / r- | u- (ru- minus r after the aspect prefix) / r- |
| 1p | oj- / oj- | öj | qa- / q- | qa- / q- |
| 2p | ix- / ix- | ïx | i- / iw- | i- / iw- |
| 3p | e- / e'- | e | ki- / k- | ki- / k- |

### Greetings and replies

| Opening | Reply | Closing |
|---|---|---|
| Xseqër k'a. | Xseqër, matyöx. | Matyöx k'a ri'. |
| Xqa q'ij k'a. | Xqa q'ij, matyöx. | Ke ri' k'a. |
| Xoq'a' k'a. | Xoq'a', matyöx. | Chwa'q chik. |
| ¿La ütz awäch? | Ütz, matyöx. ¿La ütz awäch rat? | Ch'o'n chik k'a. |
| ¿Achike ab'anon? | Majun k'ayewal. / Ütz. | |
| ¿La yab'iyaj? | Ja', yib'iyaj. | |
| ¿At k'o? | Ja', in k'o. | |
| ¿Xape? | Ja', xipe. | |

### Names and origin

| Question | Answer pattern |
|---|---|
| ¿Achike ab'i' (rat)? | (Rin) X nub'i'. |
| ¿Achike rub'i' rija'? | (Rija') X rub'i'. |
| ¿La X ab'i'? | Ja', X nub'i'. / Manäq, man X ta nub'i'. |
| ¿Aj akuchi' rat? | (Rin) in aj PLACE. |
| ¿Achike rub'i' atinamit? | PLACE rub'i' nutinamit. |
| ¿La at aj PLACE? | Ja', in aj PLACE. / Manäq, man in aj PLACE ta. |

|---|---|---|
| 1s | nub'i' | nutinamit |
| 2s | ab'i' | atinamit |
| 3s | rub'i' | rutinamit |
| 1p | qab'i' | qatinamit |
| 2p | ib'i' | itinamit |
| 3p | kib'i' | kitinamit |

### Politeness kit

| Function | Phrase |
|---|---|
| thank you | Matyöx. / Matyöx chawe. |
| you're welcome | Man tab'ij ke ri'. / Ütz k'a. |
| please | Tab'ana' utzil. |
| sorry, excuse me | Kinakuyu'. / Takuyu' numak. |
| yes / no | Ja'. / Manäq (näq). |
| I don't know | Man wetaman ta. |
| come in | Katok. |
| give my regards to X | Taya' rutzil ruwäch X. |

## Chapter 4: Pronouns and "Being"

*Independent pronouns*

| | sg | pl |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | rin (var. yïn) | röj |
| 2 | rat | rix |
| 3 | rija' | rije' |

*Set B free forms with non-verbal predicates*

| | sg | pl |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | in tijonel | öj tijonela' |
| 2 | at tijonel | ïx tijonela' |
| 3 | Ø tijonel | e tijonela' |

*Sentence frames*

| Frame | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| (PRONOUN) + SetB + NOUN | Rin in tijonel. | I am a teacher. |
| SetB + ADJECTIVE | At kosnäq. | You are tired. |
| PREDICATE + ri NOUN | Ajkem ri te Ixk'at. | Ixk'at is a weaver. |
| NAME + Set A-b'i' | Tojil rub'i'. | His name is Tojil. |
| aj + PLACE | In aj Iximche'. | I am from Tecpán. |
| ¿La + statement? | ¿La at tijonel? | Are you a teacher? |
| man + SetB + PRED + ta | Man in tijonel ta. | I am not a teacher. |
| man + PRONOUN + ta + ri NOUN | Man rin ta ri tijonel. | It is not me who is the teacher. |
| PRONOUN + chuqa' | Rin chuqa'. | Me too. |

## Chapter 5: Possession

*Set A prefixes*

| | before C | before V |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | nu- | w- |
| 2s | a- | aw- |
| 3s | ru- | r- |
| 1p | qa- | q- |
| 2p | i- | iw- |
| 3p | ki- | k- |

*What happens to the noun*

| Behavior | Example | Typical members |
|---|---|---|
| 1 no change | wuj > nuwuj | most nouns, all new words |
| 2 lax > tense | ch'akät > nuch'akat | -b'äl instruments/places, -ik action nouns, some others |
| 3 drops suffix | jolomaj > nujolom, te'ej > nute' | body parts, kin |
| 4 adds -Vl | b'aq > nub'aqil | inner body parts, abstracts, inherent possession |
| 5 always possessed | wichin, roma, rik'in | relational nouns |
| 6 root changes | jay > wochoch | house, blanket, midwife |

*Word order*

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ru-N ri POSSESSOR | rochoch ri tijonel | the teacher's house |
| ru-N ru-N ri POSSESSOR | rochoch rutata' ri a Tojil | Tojil's father's house |
| N-poss + pronoun | nupo't rin | my blouse (mine) |
| re N-poss re' | re nupo't re' | this blouse of mine |
| Set A-ichin | richin ri a Tojil | it is Tojil's |
| k'o + N-poss | k'o jun nuxib'al | I have a brother |

*Kin terms (1s)*: nute', nutata', wati't, numama', nunimal, nuchaq', nuxib'al (woman's brother), wana' (man's sister), nuk'ajol, nume'al (man's children), wal (woman's child), wixjayil, wachijil, wali', nuji', numam, wiy, nuch'ititata', nuch'itite', wach'alal.

| Frame | Example | Meaning |

| k'o (jun) N (PLACE) | K'o jun tijob'äl pa Chiq'a'l. | There is a school in Comalapa. |

| PLACE k'o wi ri N | Pa Chiq'a'l k'o wi ri tijob'äl. | It's in Comalapa that the school is. (focused place) |

## Chapter 7: Pointing Words: this, that, the, and "it was X that"

*The three frames*

| frame | meaning | with noun | fused pronoun |
|---|---|---|---|
| re ... re' | this, these (near speaker) | re wuj re' | rere' |
| la ... la' | that, those (far from speaker) | la wuj la' | lala' |
| ri ... ri' | the, that (already known) | ri wuj ri' | riri' (ideas); rija' for people |
| ri alone | the (neutral definite) | ri wuj | |

*Inside the frame:* **re** + (number) + (adjective) + (**taq**) + noun + **re'**. Possessed nouns allowed: **re nupo't re'**.

*Number:* not shown by the frame. Use a plural suffix (**ixoqi'**), **taq** (**taq wuj**), or a number.

*The ri' family*

| phrase | built from | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ja ri X | ja "it is" + ri | it is X that ..., as for X |
| ja re' / ja la' | ja + re' / la' | this is / that is |
| ke ri' (ke re') | ke "like" + ri' | like that, thus, so |
| k'a ri' | k'a "until" + ri' | then, after that |
| roma ri' (ruma ri') | r-oma "because of it" + ri' | therefore, so |
| chi ri' | chi "at" + ri' | there (known place) |
| chi la' | chi + la' | over there (far) |
| chi re' | chi + re' | here (regional) |

*Single-word deictics:* **wawe'** "here" (**waral** in Lake towns); **wakami** "now, today" (**wakamïn**, **kami**, **kamik**).

*Minimizers:* **xa** "just, merely"; **xe** "only"; **xa xe** / **xaxe** "only, just".

*Indefinite and "the other":* **jun** "a, one"; **jun chik** "another, the other"; **ri jun** "the one".

## Chapter 8: Nouns: Plurals, People Words, and Word-Building

*Plural*

| means | form | used for |
|---|---|---|
| suffix -a' / -i' | winaqi', ixoqi', achi'a', ak'wala', xtani', alab'oni', tijonela' | people, some wild animals |
| particle taq | taq wuj, taq tz'i', taq kej | everything else; optional with suffixed nouns |
| agreement | e k'o, ye-, e + adjective | required with suffixed nouns, optional with others |

*People words*

| device | example | plural |
|---|---|---|
| verb stem + -el | tijonel, k'ayinel, aq'omanel | -ela' |
| -öy/-üy + noun | b'anöy jay, ponöy wäy | no suffix |
| aj + place (two words) | aj Iximche', aj wawe' | e aj ... |
| aj + noun (one word) | ajq'ij, ajtz'ib', ajk'ay | -a'/-i' or e aj ... |

*Derived nouns*

| suffix | meaning | example | possessed |
|---|---|---|---|
| -b'äl | instrument, place | tz'ib'ab'äl, tijob'äl | nutz'ib'ab'al, qatijob'al (vowel tenses) |
| -ik / -ïk | action, product | tijonik, k'utunik | nutijonik, ruk'utunik (vowel tenses) |
| -il / -al | abstract quality | utzil, rukowil, b'eyomäl | usually possessed |

*Compounds:* ru-N N (**ruwi' q'ab'aj**); fused (**aq'awinäq**); polar pairs (**te'ej tata'aj**); noun as modifier (**samajel achin**, **kaxlan wäy**).

*Diminutive:* **ti** / **xti** / **ch'uti'n** before the noun (**jun ti ne'y**).

## Chapter 9: Describing Things and People

*Position*

| attributive | predicate | negative | question |
|---|---|---|---|
| ri nim jay | nim ri jay | man nim ta ri jay | ¿la nim ri jay? |
| jun k'ak'a' wuj | k'ak'a' ri wuj | man k'ak'a' ta | ¿la k'ak'a'? |

*With pronoun subjects:* in nim waqän, at ti'oj, Ø jeb'ël, öj rijitäq, ïx nima'q, e jeb'ël.

*Description formulas*

| question | answer pattern |
|---|---|
| ¿Achike rub'anikil? | ADJ rub'anikil NOUN: Kow rub'anikil ri ch'akät. |
| ¿Achike rub'onil? | COLOR rub'onil NOUN: Käq rub'onil ri po't. |
| ¿Achike ab'anon? (how are you) | see Chapter 3 |

*Colors:* säq, q'ëq, käq, q'än, räx (green/blue/unripe), xar, k'aqo'j, chaj; shades with C-öj: kaqköj, q'anq'öj, saqsöj, raxröj, xarxöj.

*Plural adjectives:* nim > nima'q; pim > pima'q; ri'j > rijitäq; ko'öl > koköj; used as predicates (e nima'q); all others unchanged, with e.

*Intensifiers:* janila, yalan, kan, kan qitzij, jeb'ël ütz; loman (so-so); tzay (bad excess); reduplication (ütz ütz); -aläj/-iläj (utziläj, saqaläj, rijiläj, nimaläj).

*Comparison*

| meaning | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|
| X is ADJ-er than Y | ADJ X chuwäch Y | Nim raqän rija' chuwäch runimal. |
| (borrowed) | X ri mas ADJ | Rija' ri mas nim raqän. |
| the ADJ-est | X ri ADJ | Rija' ri nim raqän. |
| as ADJ as | ADJ X achi'el Y | Nim ri jay achi'el ri jun chik. |
| not as ADJ as | man ADJ ta X achi'el Y | Man nim ta achi'el ri jun chik. |

*People:* nim raqän / ko'öl raqän (tall/short); ti'oj / b'aq; rijiläj; ütz runa'oj; q'ëq ruwi'.

*Which one:* ¿Achike NOUN ...: wi ..., wi ...? answered by ri ADJ / ja ri ADJ.

*Time of day*: nimaq'a' (morning), nik'aj q'ij / tik'il q'ij / pa q'ij (noon), tiqaq'ij (afternoon), toq'a' (evening), aq'a' / chaq'a' (night), nik'aj aq'a' (midnight).

## Chapter 11: Intransitive Verbs in the Incompletive

*The intransitive incompletive template*

```
INCOMPLETIVE (y- / n-) + Set B subject + stem
```

*Set B before a consonant stem, and the marker*

| person | prefix | with -wär |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | yi- | yiwär |
| 2s | ya- | yawär |
| 3s | n(i)- | niwär |
| 1p | yoj- | yojwär |
| 2p | yix- | yixwär |
| 3p | ye- | yewär |

*Set B before a vowel stem*

| person | prefix | with -oq' |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | yin- | yinoq' |
| 2s | yat- | yatoq' |
| 3s | n- | noq' |
| 1p | yoj- | yojoq' |
| 2p | yix- | yixoq' |
| 3p | ye'- | ye'oq' |

*Rule of thumb*: **y-** everywhere except the zero 3s, where the marker is **n-**. Before a vowel stem the 1s/2s add **-n**/**-t** (**yin-**, **yat-**) and the 3p adds a glottal (**ye'-**).

*Negation*: **man** + verb + **ta**.

*Place*: after the verb, with **pa** / **chi** / a relational noun; question or focus a place with **wi** right after the verb.

## Chapter 12: Transitive Verbs in the Incompletive

*Template:* ASPECT + Set B (object) + Set A (subject) + stem

*Aspect marker (incompletive):* **n-** before Ø object; **y-** before every other object.

*Set A (ergative) on verbs:*

| | before consonant | before vowel |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | in- | inw- |
| 2s | a- | aw- |
| 3s | u- (ru- after a vowel) | r- |
| 1p | qa- | q- |
| 2p | i- | iw- |
| 3p | ki- | k- |

*Set B (absolutive) as object:*

| | before consonant | before vowel |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | i- | in- |
| 2s | a- | at- |
| 3s | Ø | Ø |
| 1p | oj- | oj- |
| 2p | ix- | ix- |
| 3p | e- | e'- |

*"It" as object, root and derived, consonant-initial and vowel-initial:*

| | -löq' "buy" | -k'utuj "ask" | -ajo' "want" | -elesaj "take out" |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1s | ninlöq' | nink'utuj | ninwajo' | ninwelesaj |
| 2s | nalöq' | nak'utuj | nawajo' | nawelesaj |
| 3s | nulöq' | nuk'utuj | nrajo' | nrelesaj |
| 1p | nqalöq' | nqak'utuj | nqajo' | nqelesaj |
| 2p | nilöq' | nik'utuj | niwajo' | niwelesaj |
| 3p | nkilöq' | nkik'utuj | nkajo' | nkelesaj |

*Non-third-singular objects, selection (with* **-to'** *"help"):*

| | me | you | us | you all | them |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I | - | yatinto' | - | yixinto' | ye'into' |
| you | yinato' | - | yojato' | - | ye'ato' |
| he/she | yiruto' | yaruto' | yojruto' | yixruto' | yeruto' |
| we | - | yaqato' | - | yixqato' | yeqato' |
| you all | yinito' | - | yojito' | - | ye'ito' |
| they | yikito' | yakito' | yojkito' | yixkito' | yekito' |

*Word order:* Verb - Object - Subject is neutral; Subject - Verb - Object for topic/emphasis.

*Recipients:* **chwe**, **chawe**, **chre**, **chqe**, **chiwe**, **chike** after the verb (**ninya' ... chawe** "I give ... to you").

## Chapter 13: Talking About the Past and the Future

*The three aspect markers and their shapes*

| | before Ø Set B | before any other Set B |
|---|---|---|
| incompletive (present) | n- | y- |
| completive (past) | x- | x- |
| potential (future) | xt- | xk- |

*Intransitive paradigm in all three aspects (* **-b'e** *"go",* **-el** *"leave")*

| | incompletive | completive | potential | | incompletive | completive | potential |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1s | yib'e | xib'e | xkib'e | | yinel | xinel | xkinel |
| 2s | yab'e | xab'e | xkab'e | | yatel | xatel | xkatel |
| 3s | nib'e | xb'e | xtib'e | | nel | xel | xtel |
| 1p | yojb'e | xojb'e | xkojb'e | | yojel | xojel | xkojel |
| 2p | yixb'e | xixb'e | xkixb'e | | yixel | xixel | xkixel |
| 3p | yeb'e | xeb'e | xkeb'e | | ye'el | xe'el | xke'el |

*Transitive with "it" as object in all three aspects (* **-löq'** *"buy",* **-ajo'** *"want")*

| | incompletive | completive | potential | | incompletive | completive | potential |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1s | ninlöq' | xinlöq' | xtinlöq' | | ninwajo' | xinwajo' | xtinwajo' |
| 2s | nalöq' | xalöq' | xtalöq' | | nawajo' | xawajo' | xtawajo' |
| 3s | nulöq' | xulöq' | xtulöq' | | nrajo' | xrajo' | xtirajo' |
| 1p | nqalöq' | xqalöq' | xtiqalöq' | | nqajo' | xqajo' | xtiqajo' |
| 2p | nilöq' | xilöq' | xtilöq' | | niwajo' | xiwajo' | xtiwajo' |
| 3p | nkilöq' | xkilöq' | xtikilöq' | | nkajo' | xkajo' | xtikajo' |

*Third-person Set A: r or no r?*

| position | form | examples |
|---|---|---|
| after an aspect prefix, before a consonant | u- | nulöq', xulöq', xtulöq' |
| after an aspect prefix, before a vowel | r- (xt- adds i) | nrajo', xrajo', xtirajo' |
| after a Set B vowel, before a consonant | ru- | yarutz'ët, xarutz'ët, xkarutz'ët |
| after a Set B vowel, before a vowel | r- | yarajo', xarajo', xkarajo' |

*Sample of non-zero objects across aspects*

| meaning | incompletive | completive | potential |
|---|---|---|---|
| I see you | yatintz'ët | xatintz'ët | xkatintz'ët |
| you see me | yinatz'ët | xinatz'ët | xkinatz'ët |
| she helps us | yojruto' | xojruto' | xkojruto' |
| they call you all | yixkoyoj | xixkoyoj | xkixkoyoj |
| we see them | yeqatz'ët | xeqatz'ët | xkeqatz'ët |

*Time words:* **iwir**, **kab'ijir**, **oxijir**, N **q'ij kan**, **huqub'ixir**, **junab'ir**, **ojer (kan)** / **chwa'q**, **kab'ij**, **oxij**, N **q'ij apo**, **huqub'ix apo**, **ri juna' apo**. *Modifiers:* **yan** "already", **chik** "again / any more", **majani** "not yet", **k'a ... na** "still", **majun b'ey** "never". *Connectors:* **nab'ey**, **k'a ri'**, **töq**, **k'a**, **roma**, **k'isib'äl**.

## Chapter 14: Commands, Requests, and Wishes

### The imperative prefix

| Before | Prefix | Intransitive example | Transitive example |
|---|---|---|---|
| zero 3sB | t- | tib'e "let him go" | tab'ana' "do it" |
| any other Set B | k- | katz'uye' "sit" | kinato' "help me" |

### Intransitive commands by person

| Person | Before consonant | Before vowel |
|---|---|---|
| let me | ki- (kiwär) | kin- (kinuxlan) |
| you | ka- (katz'uye') | kat- (katok) |
| let him/her | ti- (tib'e) | t- (tok) |
| let's | koj- (kojb'e) | koj- (kojel) |
| you all | kix- (kixwa') | kix- (kixok) |
| let them | ke- (keb'e) | ke'- (ke'ok) |

### Transitive commands with "it" as object (root -b'än and derived -k'utuj)

| Subject | Root transitive | Derived transitive |
|---|---|---|
| let me | tinb'ana' | tink'utuj |
| you | tab'ana' | tak'utuj |
| let him/her | tub'ana' | tuk'utuj |
| let's | tiqab'ana' | tiqak'utuj |
| you all | tib'ana' | tik'utuj |
| let them | tikib'ana' | tikik'utuj |

### Suffix on root transitives

| Root vowel | Suffix | Tense the root vowel | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| ä | -a' | yes | tab'ana' |
| ö | -o' | yes | taloq'o' |
| ü | -u' | yes | tak'utu' |
| i, ë | -a' | yes (ë to e) | tatija', tasela' |
| glottal-final root | none | already tense | taya', tatzu', kinato' |
| -b'ij "say", -k'waj "carry" | none (exception) | | tab'ij, tak'waj |

### Negatives

| Form | Force |
|---|---|
| man + imperative + ta | ordinary prohibition |
| man + imperative (no ta) | routine, assumed compliance (man tab'ij ke ri') |
| mani + incompletive | prohibition, often to children (mani nachäp) |

## Chapter 15: Directionals and Verbs of Motion

### The six directionals

| Particle | Meaning | With motion verbs | With transfer verbs | Time / other |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pe | hither | xtzolin pe "came back" | xink'äm pe "I brought" | nk'astäj pe "wakes up" |
| el | away, out | xel el "went out" | xuk'ayij el "sold off" | |
| apo | thither | | tab'ij apo chre "tell her" | huqub'ix apo "in seven days" |
| kan | remaining | xkanäj kan "stayed" | xuya' kan "left it" | kaji' q'ij kan "four days ago" |
| qa | down | xtzaq qa "fell down" | | xwär qa "fell asleep" |
| aqanäj | up | njote' aqanäj "rises up" | | |

### Slot order after the verb

VERB + wi / ta + DIRECTIONAL + object / complement

### Arrive, go, come

| Meaning | Verb | Viewpoint |
|---|---|---|
| go | -b'e | away from speaker |
| come | -pe | toward speaker |
| arrive there | -apon | at a distant place |
| arrive here | -oqa | at speaker's place |
| return | -tzolin (+ pe / el) | back toward / back away |

### Destination marking

| Destination | Marker | Example |
|---|---|---|
| common noun | pa | yib'e pa k'ayb'äl |
| possessed place | chi (or pa) | xkib'e chi wochoch |
| town name | none | nb'e Iximche' |

### Go-and-do

ASPECT + Set B + b'e + (Set A) + stem (+ -V' if root transitive): xb'entz'eta', xib'ekarun, xojb'eb'iyaj

## Chapter 16: States, Results, and Ongoing Actions

*Three families of non-verbal predicate (all take in / at / Ø / öj / ïx / e)*

| Family | Formation | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| intransitive perfect | stem + -inäq / -näq | kosinäq, b'enäq | tired, gone |
| transitive perfect | possessive Set A + stem + -on / -Vn | nutz'eton, wetaman | I've seen it, I know |
| positional stative | root + lax vowel copy + l (or -an) | tz'uyül, xulan | seated, down |

*Possessive Set A on the transitive perfect*

| Person | Before consonant | Before vowel |
|---|---|---|
| 1s | nu- (nub'anon) | w- (wetaman) |
| 2s | a- (ab'anon) | aw- (awetaman) |
| 3s | ru- (rub'anon) | r- (retaman) |
| 1p | qa- (qab'anon) | q- (qetaman) |
| 2p | i- (ib'anon) | iw- (iwetaman) |
| 3p | ki- (kib'anon) | k- (ketaman) |

*Event vs state*

| Event (verb with aspect) | State (non-verbal predicate) |
|---|---|
| xwär "he slept" | warinäq "he is asleep" |
| xb'e "she went" | b'enäq "she is gone" |
| xikos "I got tired" | in kosinäq "I'm tired" |
| yitz'uye' "I'm sitting down" | in tz'uyül "I'm seated" |
| xkäm "it died" | kaminäq "it is dead" |
| nintz'ët "I see it" | nutz'eton "I have seen it" |

*Perfect vs antipassive*

| Perfect (Set A) | Antipassive (Set B) |
|---|---|
| nutz'eton "I have seen it" | yitz'eton "I see (things)" |
| rub'anon "she has done it" | nb'anon "she does (things)" |

*Time particles*

| already | still | not yet | no longer | never | again |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| chik, yan | k'a ... na | majani, ma jani ta | man ... ta chik | majun b'ey | jun b'ey chik |

## Chapter 17: Wanting, Liking, Needing, Being Able

| Meaning | Pattern | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| want X | Set A + -ajo' + noun | ninwajo' jun kape | transitive, pre-vowel Set A |
| want to do | -ajo' + inflected verb | ninwajo' yib'e | second verb incompletive |
| want someone to | -ajo' + verb with other subject | ninwajo' yab'e | chi sometimes heard |
| would like | -ajo' ta | ninwajo' ta jun kape | ta = irrealis |
| long for | -rayij + noun/verb | ninrayij ninwetamaj | stronger than -ajo' |
| like X | nqa chi -wäch | nqa chi nuwäch | liked thing is subject |
| like Xs | yeqa chi -wäch | yeqa chi nuwäch | plural subject |
| like to do | nqa chi -wäch + verb | nqa chi nuwäch yisamäj | |
| like look/sound/taste | ütz + -tz'ët / -ak'axaj / -na' | ütz ninna' | sense verb |
| X is more ... than Y | adjective + X + chuwäch Y | jeb'ël X chuwäch Y | comparison device |
| need X | nik'atzin + chwe etc. | nik'atzin chwe jun wuj | needed thing is subject |
| need (possessed) | nik'atzin + possessed noun | nik'atzin qapwäq | "our money is needed" |
| have to | k'o chi + verb | k'o chi yib'e | neutral obligation |
| don't have to | man k'atzinel ta + verb | man k'atzinel ta yab'e | denial of necessity |
| should | hortative + ta | tiqalöq' ta | soft advice (Chapter 14) |
| can (ability, possibility) | Set B + -tikir + verb | yitikir yib'e | aspect on -tikir only |
| know how | Set A + -etaman + verb | wetaman yikemon | no aspect prefix |
| know that / know someone | -etaman chi / -etaman ruwäch | wetaman chi ... | |
| may I | ¿La yitikir ...? | ¿La yitikir yinok? | |

## Chapter 18: Voice: Passive, Antipassive, and Focus

*Stem derivation*

| Verb type | Active | Passive | Antipassive |
|---|---|---|---|
| root transitive | -b'än | -b'an (tense vowel) or -b'anäx | -b'anon |
| root, glottal-final | -to' | -to' (no change; pronouns decide) | -to'on |
| derived -Vj | -tz'ib'aj | -tz'ib'äx | -tz'ib'an |
| positional -Vb'a' | -tz'uyub'a' | -tz'uyub'äx | (not treated in this book) |

*One event three ways*

| Voice | Verb shape | Subject marked by | Example | English |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| active transitive | ASPECT-B-A-stem | Set A (agent), Set B (patient) | xukem ri po't | she wove the blouse |
| passive | ASPECT-B-stem(passive) | Set B = patient | xkem ri po't (roma rija') | the blouse was woven (by her) |
| antipassive | ASPECT-B-stem-on/-Vn | Set B = agent | xkemon (richin ri po't) | she wove / she did weaving |

*When the antipassive is required*

| Situation | Example | English |
|---|---|---|
| agent questioned | ¿Achike xkemon? | Who wove it? |
| agent relativized | ri ixöq ri xkemon | the woman who wove |
| agent focused with ja | ja ri te Ixk'at xkemon | it was te Ixk'at who wove |
| object incorporated | nkemon po't | she weaves blouses |

In the first three rows (the agent-focus uses) a patient noun phrase keeps its article: **¿Achike xkemon re po't re'?** Only the incorporated object of the last row must be bare.

## Chapter 19: Positionals

| Form | Suffix | Shape | Subject/agent marking | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| stative | -Vl (lax copy); -an after l, r | CVCVl | free Set B: in, at, Ø, öj, ïx, e | in tz'uyül, xulan |
| intransitive | -e' | CVCe' | Set B prefixes + aspect | yitz'uye', xitz'uye', katz'uye' |
| transitive | -Vb'a' (tense copy) | CVCVb'a' | Set A agent + Set B patient | nintz'uyub'a', xinjotob'a' |
| passive | -Vb'äx | CVCVb'äx | Set B patient | xtz'uyub'äx |
| adjective sg | -V1C1ik | CVCVCik | none (modifier/predicate) | setesik |
| adjective pl | -V1C1äq | CVCVCäq | with e | e setesäq |

| Phase | Use |
|---|---|
| getting into the position | -e' verb (yitz'uye') |
| the change happened | -e' verb, completive (xitz'uye') |
| being in the position | stative (in tz'uyül) |
| putting someone into it | -Vb'a' (nintz'uyub'a') |
| characteristic shape or state | adjective (setesik) |

## Chapter 20: Negation, Doubt, and "If only"

*The frame and its relatives*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| man xb'e ta | he didn't go (plain negation of one word) |
| man in tijonel ta | I'm not a teacher (predicate + Set B subject inside) |
| man rin ta | it's not me (the pronoun itself negated) |
| man pa ruwi' ta ri ch'akät | not on the chair (the relation negated) |
| man pa ruwi' ri ch'akät ta | not on the chair, elsewhere (the whole phrase negated) |
| majun nupwäq | I have no money (majun + noun) |
| Manäq, man xib'e ta. | No, I didn't go. (manäq as "no", then the frame) |
| man katz'uye' ta | don't sit down (real prohibition) |
| mani nachäp | don't touch it (soft prohibition) |
| man tab'ij ke ri' | don't mention it (routinized rule, no ta) |
| xab'ij ta chwe | you should have told me (ta alone) |
| manta k'o nupwäq, xtinlöq' ta | if I had money I'd buy it (unreal if ... then would) |

*Scope at a glance*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| Man chanin ta xwär. | It wasn't QUICKLY that he fell asleep. |
| Man xwär ta chanin. | He didn't fall asleep quickly. |
| Man rin ta ri tijonel. | It isn't ME who is the teacher. |
| Rin man in tijonel ta. | As for me, I'm not a teacher. |

*Negative time and degree phrases*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| man ... ta chik | no longer |
| mani chik | not again |
| majani | not yet |
| k'a ... na | still |
| man kan ta | not very |
| majun b'ey | never |
| majun akuchi' | nowhere |
| majun rub'eyal | no way |
| majun achike ta | it's nothing (you're welcome) |
| rik'in jub'a' | maybe |

## Chapter 21: Asking Questions

*Yes/no questions*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| ¿La yab'e? | Are you going? (la + statement) |
| ¿Yab'e? | You're going? (statement + rising tune) |
| Yab'e, ¿peja'? | You're going, right? (statement + tag) |
| ¿La man yab'e ta? | Aren't you going? (la + negative frame) |

*Answers*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| Ja', yib'e. | Yes, I'm going. (ja' + echo) |
| Manäq, man yib'e ta. | No, I'm not going. (manäq + frame) |
| Manäq, majun. | No, there is none. |

*Question words*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| ¿Achike xloq'on? | Who bought it? (achike; antipassive because the doer is asked) |
| ¿Achike xulöq'? | What did he buy? (achike; plain transitive because the object is asked) |
| ¿Akuchi' xab'e wi? | Where did you go? (akuchi' + wi) |
| ¿Aj akuchi' rat? | Where are you from? |
| ¿Jampe xatoqa? | When did you arrive? |
| ¿Jaru rajil? | How much is it? |
| ¿Achike roma yatoq'? | Why are you crying? (answer: roma ...) |
| ¿Achike rub'eyal nab'än? | How do you do it? |
| ¿Achike ramaj yayakatäj? | What time do you get up? |
| ¿Achoj ichin re'? | Whose is this? |
| ¿Achoj ik'in xab'e wi? | With whom did you go? (+ wi) |
| ¿Achoq oma yab'ison? | Because of whom are you sad? |

*Embedded questions*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| Man wetaman ta akuchi' k'o wi. | I don't know where it is. (verb + question word) |
| Man wetaman ta wi xapon. | I don't know whether it arrived. (negated verb + wi) |
| Wetaman chi xapon. | I know that it arrived. (verb + chi) |

## Chapter 23: Connecting Ideas and Keeping a Conversation Going

*Joining like with like*

| Kaqchikel pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| A, B, C (juxtaposition) | Xiwa', xiwär. | I ate and slept. |
| A chuqa' B | ixim chuqa' kinäq' | corn and beans |
| A rik'in B (r-ik'in "with") | xta Ixchel rik'in rute' | Ixchel and/with her mother |
| A, k'a ri' B | Xatin, k'a ri' xwa'. | He bathed, then ate. |

*Contrast*

| Kaqchikel pattern | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A, xa ja ri' B | A, but B |
| A, ma ja ri' B | A, but B (more emphatic) |
| A, xa (xe) B | A; it's just that B |
| A, po B | A, but B (colloquial, from Spanish) |

*Logical links*

| Kaqchikel pattern | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Wi A, B. | If A, B. (no "then") |
| Wi A ta, B. | If A, B. (irrealis ta inside the wi clause; same plain "if") |
| man V ta wi A | not V whether A |
| Wi A, wi B. | Either A or B. |
| V chi A | V that A (say, know, hear, want) |
| Töq A, B. | When A, B. |
| Loman A, B. | While A, B. |
| B roma A. | B because A. |
| A. Roma ri' B. | A. Therefore B. |
| B richin A. | B in order that A. |
| Stape A, B. | Even though A, B. |

*Time-and-state particles*

| Kaqchikel pattern | Meaning |
|---|---|
| k'a ... na | still, yet; until ... first |
| ... chik | again; any more; already (changed) |
| ... yan | already, right away |
| jun b'ey chik | once more |
| man ... ta chik | no longer |

## Chapter 25: People, Work, Body, and Feelings

**Introducing and asking**

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| Re nute' re'. X rub'i'. | This is my mother. Her name is X. |
| ¿Achike rub'i' ri atata'? | What is your father's name? |
| ¿Jaru ajuna'? - N nujuna'. | How old are you? - I'm N. |
| ¿La at k'ulan? - In k'ulan. / Man in k'ulan ta. | Are you married? - I am. / I'm not. |
| ¿La k'o awal? / ¿La e k'o ak'ajol? | Do you have children? (to a woman / to a man) |
| ¿Achike asamaj? - Rin in X. / X nusamaj. | What do you do? - I'm an X. |
| ¿Akuchi' yasamäj wi? - Yisamäj pa X. | Where do you work? - I work at X. |

**Kin by speaker**

| Relation | Man says | Woman says |
|---|---|---|
| older sibling, same sex | nunimal | nunimal |
| younger sibling, same sex | nuchaq' | nuchaq' |
| sibling of the other sex | wana' (sister) | nuxib'al (brother) |
| cousin of the other sex | nuch'iti'ana' | nuch'itixib'al |
| younger cousin, same sex | nuch'itichaq' | nuch'itichaq' |
| child | nuk'ajol / nume'al | wal |
| grandchild | numam | wiy |

**Body: unpossessed -aj, possessed bare root**: jolomaj / nujolom; q'ab'aj / nuq'a'; aqanaj / waqän; wachaj / nuwäch.

**Pain**: nq'axon + possessed body part. **Sickness**: in yawa'; xiyawäj; aq'om; aq'omanel.

**Feelings: four frames**

| Frame | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| intransitive verb | yikiköt, nb'ison, yinüm, xikos | I'm happy, he's sad, I'm hungry, I got tired |
| Set B + adjective | in kosinäq, at yawa', e q'ab'arel | I'm tired, you're sick, they're drunk |
| k'o + possessed noun | k'o woyowal, k'o nuwaran | I'm angry, I'm sleepy |
| -pe + possessed noun | xpe woyowal, npe nuwaran | I got angry, I'm getting sleepy |

**Life events**: -aläx pe / alaxik; -k'ule' / k'ulub'ik / k'ulan; -käm / kamik / kaminäq.

## Chapter 26: Reading Real Kaqchikel

### The decoder, compressed

| Move | Look for | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| Frame | ojer kan, jun q'ij, toq, k'a ri', ke ri', wakami | 7, 10, 23 |
| Predicate | first word with x-/n-/y-/xt-/xk-/t-/k-, or k'o, noun, adjective, positional | 2, 4, 6, 19 |
| Aspect | x- completive; n-/y- incompletive; xt-/xk- potential; t-/k- imperative | 11, 13, 14 |
| Set B | i-/in-, a-/at-, Ø, oj-, ix-, e-/e'- | 11 |
| Set A | in-/inw- (on nouns nu-/w-), a-/aw-, u- (= ru-), qa-/q-, i-/iw-, ki-/k- | 12 |
| Voice | CVC lax vowel = root transitive; -Vj derived; -on/-Vn antipassive; tense root or -Vx passive; Set A + -on perfect | 16, 18 |
| Satellites | pe, el, apo, kan, qa, aqanäj; richin, roma, rik'in, chre, chuwäch, chirij, pa ruwi', chuxe' | 15, 22 |
| Particles | xa, xe, kan, k'a, na, chik, yan, ta, wi, ök | 20, 23 |

### Markers of narrative style

| Marker | Meaning in a text | Example |
|---|---|---|
| ojer / ojer kan / ojer ojer kan | "long ago" opening | Ojer kan k'o jun ti umül. |
| toq rub'anon kan | "back when it was so" | Toq rub'anon kan wawe' ... |
| k'o jun ... | introduces a new character | K'o jun rachib'il. |
| ri ... / re ... re' | tracks a known character | Ri umül, re achin re' |
| k'a ri' | "then" | K'a ri' xuköl el ri utiw. |
| ke ri' | "thus, so" | Ke ri' xkib'ij kan. |
| k'ate' | "suddenly" | K'ate' xrak'axaj jun q'ojom. |
| roma ri' | "therefore" | Roma ri', wakami ... |
| xa / xe | "just / only" | Xa man xch'o'n ta pe. |
| xcha' | "he/she said" (after speech) | "¿Achike at?" xcha'. |
| Set A + stem + -on | perfect, "has done" | kib'anon, rub'in kan |
| couplet | paired nouns or verbs | qate' qatata'; xuya', xusipaj |

## Chapter 28: Ri awän - the milpa, from seed to table

*The life of the plant*

| Stage | Word | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| seed | ija'tz | ntik "it is planted" |
| sprout | awex | nb'os pe "it comes up" |
| plant / field | awän | nk'iy pe, yenimïr |
| young ear | och' | yepe ri och' |
| green ear | äj | ye'ok äj; nsa'öx, ntij |
| dried ear | jäl | nupo' ri' jäl; njach' |
| grain | ixim | nb'iq; njok'; ntij |

*The four voices on one root*

| Voice | Form | English |
|---|---|---|
| active | Xuk'ät ri wäy. | She burned the tortillas. |
| passive | Xek'at ri wäy (roma ...). | The tortillas were burned (by ...). |
| antipassive | Xk'aton. | She did burning. |
| middle | Xek'atitäj ri wäy. | The tortillas got burned. (no agent at all) |

*Middle voice formation: passive stem + linking vowel + -täj*

| Pattern | Examples |
|---|---|
| -itäj | k'atitäj, paxitäj |
| echo vowel + täj | b'anatäj, tzakatäj, jok'otäj, puq'utäj, tz'etetäj |
| bare -täj | yojtäj, tijtäj |
| fixed forms | xb'anatäj, xk'ulwachitäj "it happened"; nilitäj "it turns up" |

*What happened?*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| ¿Achike xb'anatäj? | What happened? |
| ¿Achike xk'ulwachitäj? | What happened? What occurred? |
| ¿Achike xaruk'ulwachij? | What happened to you? |
| Majun xk'ulwachitäj. | Nothing happened. |

*Smells*

| Good | Bad |
|---|---|
| jub'ül (nijub'ulin) fragrant | chuw (nchuwïr pe) stinky |
| ki', simil delicious | ch'äm (nch'amïr) sour |
| k'ok' sharp (chile; also scorched) | q'ayinäq (nq'äy pe) rotten |
| | xex fishy; k'isïk' urine-like |
| | qoq foul; q'unq'uj musty; k'atinäq burnt |

## Chapter 29: B'anob'äl - Crafts and the Work of Hands

*Trade talk: three ways to say what someone does*

| Frame | Example | English |
|---|---|---|
| active transitive (specific object) | Nukem ri po't. | She is weaving the po't. |
| antipassive + bare object (habit, trade) | Nikemon po't. | She weaves po'ts. |
| maker noun as predicate | Kemoy po't rija'. | She is a po't-weaver. |

*The three agent-noun machines*

| Machine | Example | English |
|---|---|---|
| verb stem + -el | k'ayinel, tijonel, tikonel, aq'omanel | vendor, teacher, planter, healer |
| aj- + noun | ajkem, ajq'ij, ajtz'aq, ajb'o'j, ajt'ison | weaver, daykeeper, builder, potter, tailor |
| antipassive with n > y + bare object | kemoy po't, ponoy wäy, b'anoy si', yuq'uy karne'l | po't-weaver, tortilla-maker, woodcutter, shepherd |
| lexicalized -oy | q'atoy tzij | judge, authority |
| stacked | ajb'anöy chakäch | basket-maker |

*Process description*

| Piece | Example | English |
|---|---|---|
| rub'anik + noun | rub'anik ri pop | how the mat is made |
| ru- + passive stem + -ik/-xik | rukemik, ruqupixik, ruk'ayixik, ruloq'ik | the weaving / cutting / selling / buying of it |
| ordinals + pa ruk'isib'al | nab'ey, ruka'n, rox ... pa ruk'isib'al | first, second, third ... finally |
| passives carry the steps | nikanüx, nixol, nib'an, niya'öx, nik'ayïx | it is sought, mixed, made, put, sold |

*The instrumental voice (recognition only)*

| Old (instrument fronted, verb + -b'ej) | Modern equivalent |
|---|---|
| INSTRUMENT + x-Ø-in-löq'-b'ej + OBJECT | Xinlöq' + OBJECT + rik'in + INSTRUMENT |

## Chapter 30: Samaj - Work, Home, and Town

*The rapidity suffix (Comalapa, Poaquil)*

| Form | Rule | Example |
|---|---|---|
| STEM-xta-n | intransitive verb | xelxtan "she left quickly"; xojwaxtan "we ate quickly" |
| STEM-xta-j | transitive verb | xuloqxtaj "he quickly bought it"; xkijaqxtaj "they opened it quickly" |
| any aspect | n- / x- / xt- as usual | nelxtan, xelxtan, xtelxtan |
| stem changes | vowel tenses; final glottal simplifies | b'än > b'anxtaj; wa' > waxtan; löq' > loqxtaj |

*The repetitive-distributive suffix*

| Stem | Rule | Example |
|---|---|---|
| -Vj derived | -Vj > -Vla' | -k'utuj > -k'utula' "keep asking" |
| CVC root | copy vowel + -la' | -b'än > -b'anala' "do again and again" |
| CV' root | -la' directly | -to' > -tola' "help one after another" |
| meaning | repeated action or many objects/recipients | Xe'intola' ri tijoxela'. |

| sensation on you (ch- -ij) | k'o k'atän chwij; k'o raxtew chrij | I have a fever; he has chills |
| something in a body part | k'o ya' chi nupam; k'o rupam | I have diarrhea; she is pregnant |

## Chapter 32: Ri qach'ab'äl: Language, Community, and Nation

*The doubled particle*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| we ... (wi ...) | if ... |
| we A we B / wi A wi B | either A or B |
| man wetaman ta wi A wi B | I don't know whether A or B |
| ¿La nawajo' A? ¿La nawajo' B? | choice questions: ask twice, no "or" |

*Two relatives*

| Kaqchikel | English |
|---|---|
| ri ixöq ri xkemon ri po't | the woman who wove the blouse (classic; agent relative takes the antipassive) |
| ri achin chi xsamäj pa awän | the man who worked in the cornfield (modern chi; everyday speech) |
| ri po't chi xintz'ët pa k'ayb'äl | the blouse that I saw in the market |
| xub'ij chi ... | she said that ... (the bridge the relative use grew from) |

*The story of "and" and its friends*

| English | Old Kaqchikel | Spanish loan | Purist replacement |
|---|---|---|---|
| and | (nothing: juxtaposition) | i (< y) | chuqa'; rik'in |
| but | xa ja ri' | po (< pero) | xa ja ri' |
| then | k'a ri' | tons, to (< entonces) | k'a ri' |
| although | stape | aunke (< aunque) | stape |
| because | roma ~ ruma | porke (< porque) | roma |

*Register at a glance*

| Feature | Formal / choloj | Everyday talk | The feed |
|---|---|---|---|
| parallelism, couplets | dense, structural | present (back-channels, echo) | occasional |
| Spanish loans | avoided | po, tons, i normal | free mixing, whole sentences |
| spelling | full ALMG (ä, ë, ') | - | diacritics and ' often dropped |
| new words | archaisms revived | some neologisms | neologisms and English side by side |
